title: Placed Consumer Accounts Service Times for Direct-Payment Posting and Overpayment Refunds
content:
Payment Operations service standard for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. Two service times vary by placement stage: the time within which a direct payment the client reports is posted to the account, and the time within which an overpayment is refunded to the consumer.

| Stage | Direct payment posted within (business days after the client's report) | Overpayment refunded within (business days after the overpaying payment) |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 2 | 10 |
| Primary Placement | 3 | 10 |
| Secondary Placement | 3 | 10 |
| Tertiary Placement | 3 | 10 |
| Warehouse Placement | 5 | 15 |
| Legal Review Placement | 2 | 10 |

## Definitions

- **Direct payment posting time**: the number of business days after the client reports that the consumer paid the client directly, within which that payment is posted to the placed account.
- **Overpayment refund time**: the number of business days after the payment that created an overpayment, within which the overpayment is refunded.

## Reading the table

- Warehouse Placement has the longest service times in both columns (5 and 15 business days).
- Early-Out Placement and Legal Review Placement post client-reported direct payments fastest, within 2 business days.
- Five of the six stages refund an overpayment within 10 business days.
